Blog Improvements

2026 05 02

This is a super boring one, i'll stick to bullet points

  • Fixed some minor issues in the markdown parser
  • Fixed some code style issues (thanks to -Wall and -Wextra)
  • Added a static assets directory, it moves the contents of static/\*.* to the dist folder
  • Fixed some dumb memory leaks and access violations thanks to -fsanitize=address

> The big hitters here were incorrectly copying the 200 byte blog previews (correct usage would be to copy the minimum of strlen AND 200)

  • Finally I added a method to actually process blog posts, they're now wrapped in an article tag AND they have a previous/next button at the bottom
